annotationMethod: Assistant visual annotation of original 400% nearest-neighbour crops, with detector overlays hidden during this pass. Annotator has historical exposure to earlier audits. Independent second review is recorded separately. These are provisional visual measurements, not human-certified ground truth.
coordinateSystem: Displayed 4x PNG pixel coordinates. Polyline order is visible proximal attachment, distal shaft, tip. Each coordinate divides by four into native source-crop pixels.
rootMeaning: Attachment to the visible merged dark lash line. Individual biological roots are not resolved.

eyes.notes: Selected separated central upper shafts. Thick outer clumps and fine crossing textures remain unlabelled. This is a sampled subset, not exhaustive coverage.
Outer mascara-like clumps make individual root identity uncertain. Labels follow visible separated distal shafts only.
Several distal ends are soft. Root positions are visible merged-line attachments. Background scalp hair on the outer side is excluded.
Separated upper shafts are visible but their exact root boundaries merge. Fine inner-corner and overlapping outer hairs are not exhaustively labelled.
At native crop resolution the upper lash line blends with blue makeup and blur. Cannot confidently place distinct root-to-tip paths from this crop. Zero labels is not proof that no lashes exist.
Short dark marks near the upper line cannot be reliably separated from makeup/compression in this source. No invented positive structures.
